title: Missing fallback for None environ in get_response
detail: get_response now accepts environ: None = None but no longer calls _get_environ to provide a default environ. If environ is None, the code later expects a dict and will raise a TypeError when accessing keys. This breaks callers that rely on the previous behaviour of defaulting to an empty environ.

title: Incorrect flag passed to _maybeDeferred_coro
detail: The second argument to _maybeDeferred_coro is a boolean indicating whether the wrapped function is async. Passing False causes the coroutine returned by stat_file to be treated as a regular function, resulting in a coroutine object instead of a Deferred. Subsequent calls to addCallback on this coroutine will raise an AttributeError, breaking file processing when stat_file is async.
